name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v542: Invisible mode never shows popups. When 'Hide Cloudflare WebView (invisible solve)' is enabled, the bypass WebView solves silently in the background and never falls back to a visible dialog — not for AnimePahe, not for kwik.cx. If the headless solver can't crack a challenge (e.g. Turnstile checkbox), it fails silently instead of popping a Cloudflare overlay over your player. kwik.cx remains in the bypass list so its Cloudflare challenges are also solved invisibly and the cookie jar isn't wiped by CloudflareKiller. All v541 fixes retained: kwik.cx in bypass, 15-second solve cooldown, 30-second poll timeout, always require cf_clearance, removed dead JS cookie probe, clear in-flight bypass on dismiss, background API config load, tightened WebView security, removed double-poll, alpha=0 invisible attach.
